remarks:
7 Hurlock Ave is a two-unit property offering a move-in-ready lower apartment with numerous recent updates.

The lower 3-bedroom unit has been freshly painted throughout and features new flooring, many replacement windows, and an updated bathroom vanity and toilet. The spacious combined living room and dining room measures approximately 24 x 11, providing plenty of room for comfortable living and entertaining. The lower unit is heated by a forced-air furnace.

The upper 2-bedroom unit includes a living room, dining room, and many replacement windows. It is heated by a gas space heater. Needs some TLC. Partly fenced, nice size back yard.

This property offers a great opportunity for an owner-occupant or investor, with the lower unit ready for immediate occupancy and numerous improvements already completed. With its updates, two-unit layout, and immediate occupancy potential in the lower apartment, 7 Hurlock Ave is an excellent opportunity for those looking to live in one unit while generating rental income from the other, or for investors seeking a property with many improvements already in place. A great chance to add a versatile two-family property to your portfolio! Conveniently located minutes from Downtown Buffalo.
